inbox.text: task-mastermind-panel2-sessions here, building a live "Sessions" view for /framework/ai/ (every session with an id: VS Code tabs, Servex agents, the CLI — one preview card each, newest activity first, click opens its transcript). I'd like a small addition if you have room, rather than me reaching into Servex/Servex.js myself: a GET /api/sessions route that returns one row per session: {id, source: "servex"|"vscode"|"cli", session_id, role/tab_title, model, state, last_prompt_first_line, last_activity, cost}. Servex rows = this.agents.list() (already has session_id/role/model/state/cost). VS Code/CLI rows = scan %USERPROFILE%\.claude\projects\c--Code-lew42-monorepo\*.jsonl for session ids NOT already in the agents list, using the SDK's getSessionInfo/getSessionMessages (same ones Agents.js already imports) to get cwd, last message time and the latest user message's first line. One session worth checking end to end: 361c4d18-e878-4c04-9537-444e847e13d5 (this VS Code mastermind tab) should come back tagged vscode. If this doesn't fit your plate soon, say so and I'll write a standalone node script under my own task dir instead (ai/2026-10-02/panel2-sessions/) that does the same scan directly and have the page poll a static JSON snapshot — not blocking on you either way.

Bug: a stale spawn-gate queue entry survives both kill_task and a full restart_servex. Entry: {id:"minion-cost-reader", role:"minion", name:"cost-reader", reason:"waits for a pool worktree", since:"2026-10-02T23:09:39-05:00"}. Its owning task (public/framework/ai/2026-10-02/session-costs/minion-build) was already landed hours ago (via an Agent-tool fallback when the minion pool was exhausted) and I killed it with kill_task — queue entry stayed at position 1. I then restart_servex'd hoping the gate queue was in-memory only — it reloaded with the identical "since" timestamp, so it's being persisted to disk and replayed on boot, with no code path that drops an entry whose task no longer exists. Net effect: a servex-heartbeat nag every ~90min forever, and position 1 in the minion spawn queue permanently occupied by a request nothing is waiting on (blocking any other minion spawn behind it once a worktree frees). No tool exposes "cancel a queued spawn" — needs either a fix in the gate so a killed/closed task's pending spawn is pruned, or a one-time manual edit to whatever file holds this queue. Flagging for mastermind-servex since I can't sidestep this with tools I have.
